name: certen-sdk
//image: Node 20 is the middle of the CI matrix (18, 20, 22) and the version the repo is developed against. Pinning the major here means a container rebuild cannot silently move the toolchain.
//postCreateCommand: Install and build on create. The CLI and MCP packages resolve @certen.io/sdk types from its dist/, which is gitignored — so without a build, a fresh container cannot typecheck them and the failure looks like a broken checkout.

vscode.//extensions: No ESLint or Prettier: this repo has neither configured, and suggesting them invites an agent to run a linter that does not exist. `npm run typecheck` is the static gate.

//containerEnv: Writes are opt-in and stay opt-in. An agent working in this container gets the read-only MCP surface unless a human changes this deliberately.
